description: Reference history with the 2020-03-02 high set below its close (OHLC_INCONSISTENT).
explanation: An ERROR finding dated at or before as_of means the history is not trustworthy, so G0 makes the symbol DATA_INSUFFICIENT (spec 8 G0, spec 11). Nothing is repaired, and the fresh zone of the reference is not offered.
title: A data-quality ERROR dated before as-of stops the symbol
